sources.title: DataMeet indian_village_boundaries, Maharashtra (mh2.geojson with the mh.csv 2001-to-2011 crosswalk)

provenance.note: Gram Panchayat polygons for 87 Panchayats in Gadhinglaj taluka: each is the MultiPolygon of its LGD-listed member villages as DataMeet drew them from the 2001 Census village map, joined to the 2011 codes through DataMeet's own crosswalk, simplified to about 20 m (source polygons kept where simplification moved the area by more than a percent). Member villages the source did not draw are named on the feature. Indicative, not survey grade.

conventions.license: ODbL 1.0; DataMeet, indian_village_boundaries (github.com/datameet/indian_village_boundaries), ODbL 1.0. Derived polygons are share-alike under the same licence.
conventions.geometry: MultiPolygon of member villages, never dissolved, so the source parts stay auditable
conventions.vintage: the 2001 Census village map; boundaries changed since are not reflected
